goal.insight: Visually link each country's health expenditure trajectory with its maternal mortality trend to show how changes in spending correspond to changes in mortality over time
Highlight the gap between rural and urban maternal mortality rates for each country, making the magnitude of disparity visually prominent
Emphasize the variation in skilled birth attendant / midwife coverage across the eight countries and show how higher coverage countries compare in mortality outcomes
Draw attention to the countries that show the steepest decline in maternal mortality over the time period, contrasting them with countries showing slower progress
Show the relationship between health expenditure as a share of GDP and maternal mortality levels across all eight countries and time points
